Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ لَيْسَ لِيْ وَسِيْلَةٌ إِلَيْكَ إِلَّا عَوَاطِفُ رَأْفَتِكَ
Translation: My God, I have no means to approach You except through the tenderness of Your compassion

Arabic text: وَلَا لِيْ ذَرِيْعَةٌ إِلَيْكَ إِلَّا عَوَارِفُ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And I have no way to reach You except through the abundance of Your mercy
And the intercession of Your Prophet, the Prophet of mercy
The savior of the nation from distress

Arabic text: فَاجْعَلْهُمَا لِيْ سَبَبًا إِلَى نَيْلِ غُفْرَانِكَ
Translation: So make them both a means for me to attain Your forgiveness

Arabic text: وَصَيِّرْهُمَا لِيْ وُصْلَةً إِلَى الْفَوْزِ بِرِضْوَانِكَ
Translation: And make them both a connection for me to achieve success through Your pleasure
My hope has descended in the sanctuary of Your generosity
And my longing has settled in the courtyard of Your bounty
So fulfill my hopes in You
And seal my deeds with goodness

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنِيْ مِنْ صَفْوَتِكَ الَّذِيْنَ أَحْلَلْتَهُمْ بُحْبُوحَةَ جَنَّتِكَ
Translation: And make me among Your chosen ones whom You have settled in the midst of Your paradise
And whom You have lodged in the abode of Your honor

Arabic text: وَأَقْرَرْتَ أَعْيُنَهُمْ بِالنَّظَرِ إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ لِقَائِكَ
Translation: And whose eyes You have delighted by looking at You on the day of meeting You
And whom You have granted dwellings of truth in Your proximity

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ لَا يَفِدُ الْوَافِدُوْنَ عَلَى أَكْرَمَ مِنْهُ
Translation: O One to whom no visitor comes to anyone more generous than Him
And no seeker finds anyone more merciful than Him

Arabic text: يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ خَلا بِهِ وَحِيدٌ
Translation: O Best One with whom a lonely person can be alone

Arabic text: وَيَا أَعْطَفَ مَنْ آوَىٰ إِلَيْهِ طَرِيدٌ
Translation: And O Most Compassionate to whom an outcast can take refuge
To the vastness of Your forgiveness, I have extended my hand
And to the hem of Your generosity, I have clung with my palm
So do not leave me deprived
And do not afflict me with disappointment and loss
O Hearer of supplications
O Most Merciful of the merciful
